logo_guidelines.specification: The letters M and R seamlessly flow into an abstract AI node circuit line without splitting 'AI' into a disconnected sub-brand. Uses electric cyan stroke (#00E5FF) transitioning into Royal Blue (#0057D9) with a small gold node dot (#D4AF37).
logo_guidelines.usage: Displayed in the sticky header with subtle glow on hover, and in the dark footer with brand full name.

layout_and_rhythm.section_rhythm: Alternating dark (#0F111A) and crisp light/slate (#F8FAFC) sections to prevent fatigue and elevate modern enterprise feel.
layout_and_rhythm.bento_grid_structure: Grid using 12-column layout (col-span-12, col-span-8, col-span-4) with asymmetric card sizes, integrated micro-badges, interactive hover light beams, and subtle borders.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all buttons, links, inputs, forms, tabs, cards, and interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 9 specified routes render cleanly with shared layout wrapper.
Strictly follow the color tokens: Primary dark navy #0F111A, Royal Blue #0057D9, Electric Cyan #00E5FF, Gold #D4AF37 used only as subtle luxury accents.
Implement alternating light and dark sections for visual rhythm.
Ensure the contact form posts data to FastAPI backend at /api/contact or gracefully handles feedback states with toast notifications.
Ensure founders grid uses stylized initials avatars (MAS, NM, SA, MA) in SVG/CSS badge cards, NOT stock photos.
Add explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
